title: BaseUncertainRisk
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch — base/substrate 'Not sure' risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0, same convention as Slices 1-5. Sibling schema: base-surface-risk.schema.json. Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain.

BaseInput.description: The raw p.facts.base value. Exact match against 'Not sure' only. The legacy pre-27-Aug string 'Unknown' (renamed to 'Not sure'), 'Concrete slab', any surface-risk option, empty string, null, undefined, and any other unrecognised value must all produce a null output.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when base !== 'Not sure'.

text.const: Existing surface/base information is incomplete, so foundation and slab suitability cannot yet be relied upon.
